run_train_eval_runner: run a TrainEvalRunner with train and eval dataloaders to fit a model for a specified number of epochs
create_train_checkpoint_callback: create a TrainCheckpointCallback that saves checkpoints every N training steps and prunes old ones
get_recent_checkpoint_path: get the most recent viable checkpoint path from a checkpoint directory by checking for .metadata files
save_train_state: save the training state to a checkpoint location with optional preemption symlink handling
load_train_state: load the training state from a given checkpoint path or the most recent viable checkpoint
